question.text: Under SEBI PMS Regulations 2020, the client agreement must include:

answer.text: Investment objectives, services, period, investment approach, exposure proportions and fees

explanation.text: The Logic: Schedule IV lists mandatory clauses including investment objectives, IA, exposure proportions, fees, custody, audit. The Trap: Friends/forecasts/resume are not mandatory clauses. Cross-Exam Context: Mirrors III-A contract review checklist. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Create a contract checklist; every PM new-client file should satisfy all 15 Schedule IV items.
